island.comment: A `{% … %}` code island or a `{%= … %}` output island (with optional `-`/`--` whitespace-trim markers). The body embeds the Gad grammar; everything outside an island is literal template text. The open/close markers carry a `keyword.control` scope so they get a strong, user-configurable color (IntelliJ maps it to the KEYWORD color key; the VS Code extension tints it via configurationDefaults).
island.name: meta.embedded.block.gad
